How does it work? You’ll be given 5 feminization curse scenarios. Each one grants you certain benefits (often huge ones), but each also comes with serious, sometimes extremely painful or even deadly - drawbacks. Your task is to choose the one you would genuinely accept. Even though these aren’t real, try to think about them as seriously as possible and pick the one you would actually choose in real life if you had no other option. Explain why you made that choice.

Will you pick the magic hanger that delivers a brand-new outfit set every single day for the rest of your life, but might rapidly age you if you protest wearing the randomly selected hobble skirt or maid outfit? Or will you go with the sissyfication orb that absolutely destroys your anus limits… but turns you into an insanely sexy girl?
